rundown: Bears beat Lions 39-35 at Ford Field in Detroit, MI. Bears came back: they were down 19-10 at the half. The 3rd quarter decided it: Bears won it 14-7. Their win chance dropped as low as 5% along the way.
Scoring: Bears 5 touchdowns and 1 field goal; Lions 4 touchdowns and 2 field goals. The last score: Rome Odunze 6 Yd pass from Caleb Williams (Cairo Santos Kick) (4th quarter, 0:03).

Leading the way — Bears: Caleb Williams 30/44, 345 yds, 2 TD; D'Andre Swift 9 car, 65 yds, 1 TD, 7 rec, 97 yds. Lions: Jared Goff 25/36, 313 yds, 1 TD, 1 INT; Jahmyr Gibbs 21 car, 205 yds, 3 TD; Amon-Ra St. Brown 7 rec, 146 yds.
Against the closing line (Draft Kings): Bears closed as 1.5-point favorites and covered by 2.5; the total closed at 56.5 and they combined for 74, over by 17.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 26, 12:58 PM ET. It had Bears 46% and Lions 54%, projecting Bears 25 – Lions 26.3 (51.2 total, Lions by 1.3).

Final: Bears 39 – Lions 35. Wrong winner: it had Lions at 54%, and Bears (46%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Bears came in with a 11% above average attack and a 7% stingier than average defense (8-2, 26.2 scored and 19.7 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 54 and 53 games of evidence. Projected to score 25, they scored 39 (+14 points, 56% over); projected to allow 26.3, they allowed 35 (+8.7 points, 33% over).

Lions came in with a 17% above average attack and a league-average defense (8-2, 28.8 scored and 22 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 61 and 62 games of evidence. Projected to score 26.3, they scored 35 (+8.7 points, 33% over); projected to allow 25, they allowed 39 (+14 points, 56% over).

The bigger miss was Bears' scoring (+14 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 74 against 51.2 projected (+22.8), about the 96th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±13.2).

Margin: Bears by 4 against Lions by 1.3 projected, about the 34th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12.8).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Lions ×1.00, Bears ×1.02. It favored Bears, who did beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
DET ML (+101) at +101: the algo gave it 48% vs 48% fair (+0.6 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 46%). CHI ML (-119) at -119: the algo gave it 52% vs 52% fair (-0.6 pts) — won (+0.8u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 54%). DET +1.5 (-117) at -117: the algo gave it 52% vs 52% fair (+0.5 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. CHI -1.5 (-103) at -103: the algo gave it 48% vs 48% fair (-0.5 pts) — won (+1u); same number as the close. OVER 56.5 (-106) at -106: the algo gave it 48% vs 49% fair (-1.5 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. UNDER 56.5 (-113) at -113: the algo gave it 52% vs 51% fair (+1.5 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 52% of bets on Bears, 48% of the money — Bears covered; total: 17% of bets on the over, 13% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 50% of bets on Bears, 49% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Bears, who won and covered.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.417 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -6.2 points. It counts toward NFL scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 57 graded NFL games the algo now scales scoring ×0.987 and gives home teams -0.9 points. Team corrections so far: Bears attack ×1.015, defense ×1.009 (3 games); Lions attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (5 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
